prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC pixel-art speech mouth atlas
Input image: Image 1 is the only reference and layout guide: mouth-reference-grid.png, a 3×3 grid of repeated whole lower 64×29 portrait halves enlarged 8×. Use no other reference.
Primary request: Create one complete 3×3 atlas of the same lower-face halves. Preserve each cell boundary, exact crop, face identity, pixel grid, mouth scale, nose, jaw, neck, hair, background, and aspect ratio. Row-major cells: A B C / D E F / G H X. Change only lip, mouth, and minimal expression tension. Keep the afraid expression tense and restrained; retain the same shape family for each pose.
Rhubarb poses, required exactly: A closed lips with light pressure for P/B/M. B slightly open, nearly together teeth, narrow horizontal opening for most consonants and EE. C medium open mouth with relaxed unrounded lips for EH/AE. D wide vertical opening for AA, clearly larger than C. E slightly rounded lips, opening no wider than C, for AO/ER. F puckered rounded lips with a small forward opening for UW/OW/W; not a tooth bite. G upper teeth touching lower lip for F/V; not a wide vowel or pucker. H tongue raised behind upper teeth for long L, opening between C and D; tongue may be invisible at native scale. X closed relaxed idle lips. Emotion changes tension and corners without changing these pose meanings.
Palette and pixels: preserve original subdued warm tan/brown skin, softly blended brown lips, restrained warm teeth, and original pixel-art contrast. Keep facial proportions and lip scale. No orange surrounding skin, lipstick-red lips, bright white tooth blocks, heavy outlines, blur, smooth vector shapes, antialiasing, labels, margins, extra panels, or watermark.
Composition: output only the complete 3×3 atlas of lower halves, with same cell proportions and 64:29 aspect ratio as reference. Do not output a full portrait, mouth-only close-ups, alternate crop, or redesigned background.
